Build a Light or Grouped Light State Update Payload

Source: R/helpers.R
hue_payload_light.Rd

Convenience helper that constructs a validated CLIP API v2 JSON payload list suitable for hue_update_light() and hue_update_grouped_light().

Usage

hue_payload_light(
  on = NULL,
  brightness = NULL,
  mirek = NULL,
  xy = NULL,
  effect = NULL,
  dynamics_duration = NULL,
  alert = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

on

Optional logical scalar. Set TRUE to turn on or FALSE to turn off.

brightness

Optional numeric scalar in [0, 100]. Target brightness percentage.

mirek

Optional integer scalar in [153, 500]. Color temperature in mirek (153 = coolest 6500K, 500 = warmest 2000K).

xy

Optional numeric vector of length 2 (c(x, y)), each in [0, 1], specifying CIE 1931 xy chromaticity coordinates.

effect

Optional character scalar effect name (e.g., "no_effect", "candle", "fire", "prism", "sparkle", "opal", "glisten", "underwater", "cosmos", "sunbeam", "enchant").

dynamics_duration

Optional non-negative integer scalar transition duration in milliseconds.

alert

Optional character scalar alert action (e.g., "breathe").

...

Additional named CLIP API v2 fields merged into the payload (e.g., gradient, timed_effects, signaling, metadata).

Value

A named list suitable for passing as the body argument to hue_update_light() or hue_update_grouped_light().

See also

hue_update_light(), hue_update_grouped_light()

Examples

payload <- hue_payload_light(
  on = TRUE,
  brightness = 80,
  mirek = 300,
  dynamics_duration = 400
)
payload
#> $on
#> $on$on
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> 
#> $dimming
#> $dimming$brightness
#> [1] 80
#> 
#> 
#> $color_temperature
#> $color_temperature$mirek
#> [1] 300
#> 
#> 
#> $dynamics
#> $dynamics$duration
#> [1] 400
#> 
#>
